name: z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx
description: GLM-5.3-FlashX is the high-speed tier of Z.ai's GLM-5.3-Flash, documented together with Flash and delivering inference speeds of up to 200 tokens per second. It shares Flash's native multimodal design and hybrid sparse-plus-linear attention, with image, video and file input, always-on reasoning, tool calling and structured output. Pick it over standard Flash for latency-sensitive coding agents, GUI and browser tasks, and interactive chat.
